title: New York Business Registry Active Entities
description: Governed New York Department of State active-entity layer using selected business identity, filing-profile, and reported location-address fields only, with ZIP/ZCTA context, provenance, and explicit non-site semantics.
coverage_claim: Entities included in the official monthly New York Active Corporations extract; this is source-specific extract membership for general public knowledge, not proof of current legal status, a census of every operating business, or a physical-site directory.
identity_rule: Each unique one-to-eight-digit New York DOS ID becomes one provisional organization candidate. Reported location addresses remain organization assertions and never create physical sites or establishments.
